## Functions

### `Separator`

```ts
Separator(props: SeparatorProps): Html
```

A rule, optionally with a label in it; vertical for toolbars.

## Types

### `SeparatorOrientation`

- `"horizontal"`
- `"vertical"`

### `SeparatorSpacing`

Space around the rule.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `SeparatorProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string | Html` |  | Text set into the rule ("or", "Today"). |
| `orientation` | `SeparatorOrientation` |  |  |
| `spacing` | `SeparatorSpacing` |  |  |
| `decorative` | `boolean` |  | Purely visual: `aria-hidden` instead of `role="separator"`. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### "or" between two ways to sign in

```ts
html`
  ${Button({ label: "Continue with Google", variant: "outline", block: true })}${Separator({
    label: "or",
  })}${Button({ label: "Email me a link", variant: "primary", block: true })}
`
```

```html
<button type="button" class="btn btn--outline btn--block">Continue with Google</button>
<div class="separator separator--labelled" role="separator">
  <span class="separator__label">or</span>
</div>
<button type="button" class="btn btn--block">Email me a link</button>
```

### A vertical rule in a toolbar

`decorative` hides it from assistive tech; the buttons already read as groups.

```ts
html`
  ${Button({ label: "Undo", variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}${Separator({
    orientation: "vertical",
    spacing: "sm",
    decorative: true,
  })}${Button({ label: "Redo", variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
`
```

```html
<button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm">Undo</button>
<div class="separator separator--vertical separator--sm" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm">Redo</button>
```
